summary: TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a revolving credit facility. An affiliate, T-POP Finance Holdings, LLC, as borrower, obtained up to $125 million in initial capacity, expandable subject to loan-to-value ratio constraints (max 15% for new loans, 25% overall, or 30% with ≥70 eligible investments and NAV >$4.5B). Wells Fargo acts as administrative agent and lead arranger. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR plus 3.00% or base rate plus 2.00%. Maturity is August 25, 2027 with extension option. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
